label: integrated service change mgmt process: Execute quality assurance and defect prevention checks — Run automated quality gates and production order validation to ensure change will not degrade manufacturing or service operations.

args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

CHANGE MGMT & QA:
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:QualityAssuranceAndDefectPrevention:v1 ✓ BEST for QA/defect prevention in change mgmt - monitors machines & production orders, automates quality inspection, detects anomalies, triggers holds on non-conforming batches, coordinates corrective actions
Agent: sap.s4:agent:AssetLifecycleChangeOrchestrator:v1 - manages change approvals, asset provisioning

CHANGE MGMT & APPROVALS:
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1 - coordinates engineering changes, material provisioning, BOM updates, evaluates change impact on supply chain

VENDOR/MATERIAL/EQUIPMENT DEPENDENCIES:
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator:v1 - vendor qualification, material validation
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1 - validates BOM compliance, component standards

PURCHASE ORDER & PROCUREMENT:
API: sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1
Agent: sap.s4:agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent:v1

CAMPAIGN PERFORMANCE & MARKETING:
Agent: sap.crm:agent:CampaignAudienceOptimizationCoordinator:v1
Agent: emarsys.cx:agent:SegmentDrivenCampaignOptimizer:v1
